Done. Files and report complete; I ran no tests, builds, generators, or git mutations (main owns those).

## What I changed and why

SP-18's docs predated SP-17's merge, so the failing `TestNoPlannedPointerToAnExistingPage` (15 stale "planned (SP-17)" pointers) was only the surface — the same prose carried behavioural claims SP-17 had made false. I verified every corrected assertion against source, not against SP-17 prose.

**Ground truth confirmed in source:**
- `doctor`/`fsck` are **implemented, read-only** (`internal/cli/{doctor,fsck}.go`); `fsck --repair` needs `--yes`, does five additive repairs, never deletes.
- Only **`bench`** is still unimplemented (`commands.go` `notImplemented`).
- Backup/rollback (`TakeBackup`/`VerifyBackup`/`RestoreBackup`/`RehearseRollback`) is **Go-only behind the closed `store.migrate.legacyImportCutover` build gate** — `NewMigrator` returns `ErrMigrationGateClosed`; the gate has no config key and `Passed` is false. The gate **remains closed** (inspected, not assumed).
- windows/amd64 is `installed-verified` (install + launcher-in-cache); the other five `unknown`; **no live-session/live-model run** on any target.

**Edits (exclusive-editable files only):**
- **README / user-guide / troubleshooting / uat / cannot-do:** 15 planned→link conversions plus their now-false framing; `doctor`/`fsck` reframed as read-only diagnostics; installed-host scope corrected to windows/amd64-only (four not-yet-implemented contract IDs preserved for `TestCannotDoNamesTheUnimplementedChecks`).
- **UAT recovery model rewritten** per `release.md` §5: stop writers before restore, **move (never delete)** the post-run store, restore from the operator's own copy, and use **`qompack fsck` as the recovery check** — the three-index-file comparison demoted to a sanity check, no longer the certification. No CLI invented. All 12 UAT IDs and Results kept `not executed — capability unverified`; no evidence block lost.
- **`docs/architecture.md`** needed no change.
- New report: **`plans/sdd/V6-VERIFY/docs-integration.md`** (edits, source refs, test-surface safety notes, open contract issues, recommended checks).

**Verification I did do (structural, not the suite):** every new anchor slug matched against its target heading (`release.md#{3-supported-scope,4-switches,5-rollback,7-not-claimed}`, `security.md#7-…`, `user-guide.md#operator-commands`, `troubleshooting.md#9-…` all confirmed present); renamed `cannot-do.md` headings have no inbound links; no new dotted config-key code spans in `uat.md`; no residual "planned"→existing-file, "not implemented" doctor/fsck, or "compare the index files" certification phrasing.

## For main
- **Recommended checks (not run):** `go test ./test/docs/...` and re-run the focused integration.
- **Open contract issues** (report §5): version discrepancy — last tag `v0.2.0` but `core.Version`/plugin.json are `0.1.0`, which `release-check` would refuse; README "Status" framing still reads pre-SP-17; the `[requires SP-17 artifact]` marker name; and the README/cannot-do/uat prose now keyed to the generated `release.md` §3 scope table.
- **Not mine:** untracked `test/fault/v6_fsck_test.go` and `test/security/v6_authorization_test.go` appeared from another process — I left them untouched.
